decisions.reason: The charting bundle adds little cost to the core map.apps platform and has shown no clear shortfall, but it has not been visible on the website since 2020, which raises the chance it is quietly absorbed or retired.

The hierarchical search bundle was only marginally visible at launch and has since disappeared from the website, so it likely falls short of aspirations, and its resources are better redirected to core development.
As the flagship platform defining the firm's strategic direction, it stays even with reduced web visibility, since management's commitment and industry slack outweigh short-term uncertainty.
Mobile field data capture meets a core customer need close to the established offer, so despite lower visibility the firm keeps it rather than triggering problemistic search.

The search extension overlaps with other search functionality, is no longer shown on the website, and is a likely candidate for consolidation into the platform, releasing resources for new development.
